why: Tests step for the full-depth row refresh, today's CI tooling, lane B1 of issue 1333. Wrote fullSamples (93 files, runs A 44201566907, B 44155250216 and C 44077224612, each sample with its leg and job id), law F3, F1's new pins, E4 over both tables, E6 and the lane-and-others scenario over rowsAt(depth), and T1 in .github/ci/shard-times.test.ts. Red now, for the planned reason: F1 (rowsAt full answers 380.2, 167.8, 366.6, not 402.7, 200, 359.3) and F3 (full has no row for the new tooling files and the old rows for the rest), at both depths. E4, E6, F2 and the lane scenario are green on main's table at both depths, because full has no visual or tooling rows yet: they go red only if left over measured once the table lands, so their plants ran with the candidate table swapped in and restored. With the candidate table (kept outside the commit) every law in both files is green at fast and at full depth.
note: Plan gap: it lists E6 as red before the build; it is green until the table is refreshed, since the sequencer and assign agree on rows when full has no visual rows. The candidate table was generated by a one-off script in the lead's scratch folder from all.jsonl and jobs.jsonl and matched new-rows.json (93 rows, 55 changed, 38 new, neither Toml key). Every run used Node 26.13.0 with TYPESAFE_API_KEY unset, one file at a time.
